name: Crewloom QA
description: Test ZyoraERP: run the repository's check scripts on a branch, smoke-test deployed pages and audit marketing pages.

repoPath.description: Absolute path of a dedicated Zyora-erp checkout the tool may switch between refs.

allowedScripts.description: npm scripts the agent may run. Default verify, lint, test, build.

allowedHosts.description: Hosts smoke tests may open; "*.example.com" matches subdomains. Default zyoraerp.com, *.zyoraerp.com, *.vercel.app.

screenshotDir.description: Where screenshots are saved. Default the OS temp dir.

passEnv.description: Extra environment variable names npm scripts may see (public build settings only, never secrets).

gitTokenEnv.description: Env var git may use for GitHub credentials. Never passed to npm. Default CREWLOOM_GITHUB_TOKEN.

bypassSecretEnv.description: Env var with the Vercel protection bypass secret. Default VERCEL_AUTOMATION_BYPASS_SECRET.
